en: Sepia-toned studio photograph showing a uniformed soldier kissing a woman in traditional rural dress. The soldier wears a pickelhaube spiked helmet, tunic with shoulder straps and belt, tall riding boots, and carries a sabre. The woman holds a rolled paper or letter and stands beside a wicker basket with bread. The background is a painted pastoral scene, typical of early 20th‑century studio postcards. No visible printed text appears on the image side.
